title: chore(deps): refresh the lockfile
body: Runs pnpm update inside the existing ranges so the lockfile picks up the latest patch release of zod. package.json is unchanged.
author: acme-dev

files.patch:
@@ -6,13 +6,13 @@ importers:
     dependencies:
       zod:
         specifier: ^4.4.0
-        version: 4.4.1
+        version: 4.4.3
 
 packages:
 
-  zod@4.4.1:
-    resolution: {integrity: sha512-Aa1Bb2Cc3Dd4Ee5Ff6Gg7Hh8Ii9Jj0Kk1Ll2Mm3Nn4Oo5Pp6Qq7Rr8Ss9Tt0Uu1Vv2Ww3Xx4Yy5Zz6Aa7Bb8Cc9Dd0==}
+  zod@4.4.3:
+    resolution: {integrity: sha512-Zz9Yy8Xx7Ww6Vv5Uu4Tt3Ss2Rr1Qq0Pp9Oo8Nn7Mm6Ll5Kk4Jj3Ii2Hh1Gg0Ff9Ee8Dd7Cc6Bb5Aa4Zz3Yy2Xx1Ww0==}
 
 snapshots:
 
-  zod@4.4.1: {}
+  zod@4.4.3: {}
